name: Wren Summoned by General Perez
description: As Doctor Wren leaves the mess hall, an ensign approaches him and says, 'Doctor, General Perez is asking for you. We've been hailed.' Wren stops, acknowledges the message, and turns to follow the ensign.
related_events: Ensign informs Doctor Wren of General Perez's request

name: Airlock Cycle Complete and Ascent Initiated
description: The outer doors sealed beneath the ship. A rush of pressurized air filled the airlock. After a few seconds, the inner door slid open. The ship ascended into the bay.
related_events: Airlock pressurizes and inner door opens
Ship rises into the bay

name: Ripley's Dream of the Dark Chamber
description: Ripley moves through a vast, dark space at impossible speed, shifting into an air vent without slowing. She emerges into a chamber filled with a dark, writhing, inhuman mass. It surges toward her, enveloping her completely. She lies within the chamber, her eyes open but black, without whites. Her hands rise to her chest, clawing at the skin. She scratches harder, tearing into her flesh. Blood wells up and spills over her sides.
related_events: Ripley experiences a disturbing dream involving a dark, moving entity
Ripley scratches and tears at her own chest in the dream

name: Ripley Fails to Open Hatch as Newborn Breaks In
description: Ripley reaches the hatch and tries to open it, but it does not budge. She pounds on the hatch in frustration. At that moment, the newborn smashes through the window and jumps down onto the ship.
related_events: Ripley attempts to open hatch but fails
Ripley pounds on hatch in frustration
Newborn smashes through window and jumps onto the ship

name: Crew Reacts to Vessel Attachment and Begins Descent
description: The crew hears a sudden sound and looks up in alarm. Vriess calls out that something is on the vessel. Johner ignores the warning, moves to initiate descent, secures the airlock, and begins opening the outer doors.
related_events: Crew hears a sound and looks up in response
Vriess alerts crew that something is attached to the vessel
Johner dismisses the threat and initiates descent procedure
Outer airlock doors begin to open

name: Ripley's Leap to the Auriga
description: Ripley staggers to her feet after the glass shatters around her. Behind her, a heavy slam echoes against the metal door—the aliens are here. She sprints down the platform, the airlock doors ahead sliding shut. Betty vanishes inside as the gap narrows—fifteen feet, ten. Ripley reaches the edge and launches herself forward, soaring through the air over the widening drop. She plunges downward as the doors close beneath her, slipping through just in time. She crashes onto the hull of the Auriga, the impact driving the breath from her lungs, and rolls to a stop, dazed and aching.
related_events: Ripley runs along the platform after surviving the glass explosion
Aliens arrive at the metal door behind Ripley
Ripley leaps from the platform toward the airlock doors
Airlock doors close with Betty entering the airlock
Ripley falls through the closing airlock doors and lands on the Auriga

name: Ripley and the Newborn Hold On as the Betty Is Ejected
description: The Betty is hurled out of the airlock into space, launching Ripley and the newborn into sudden free fall. Ripley is thrown upward, her body slamming against the hatch door as she clings to it with all her strength. The newborn, gripping the ship with multiple limbs, also struggles to maintain hold amid the violent motion. As the Betty tumbles, it narrowly avoids colliding with the massive ATJRIGA, which speeds past below, continuing its rapid descent toward Earth.
related_events: Betty shoots out of the airlock into space
Ripley and the newborn struggle to hold on during sudden ejection
Betty narrowly avoids collision with passing ATJRIGA
ATJRIGA travels at high speed toward Earth

name: Girl Overwhelmed by Insects in Flooding Wheat Field
description: A young girl walks through a vast wheat field beside a woman, both with black, tousled hair. The woman moves farther ahead, leaving the girl behind. The girl stops, slaps at her neck, and pulls off a large, wriggling insect. More bugs land on her. She looks down to see blood rising around her feet, spreading quickly, filling the field and submerging the wheat. The blood rises higher, surrounding her completely. Insects cover her body, crawling over her arms and face. She opens her mouth to scream, and the insects pour in.
related_events: Woman in wheat field moves far ahead of girl
Girl discovers giant bug on her neck in wheat field
Blood rises and floods wheat field around girl
Girl becomes overwhelmed by swarm of insects and screams

name: Scientists Record Vital Sign Spike in Enlarged Specimen
description: The instruments register a sudden spike in the specimen's heart rate and blood pressure. The scientists note the readings and turn their attention to the specimen, now significantly larger and contained within a new case. The camera focuses on the cardiograph, then shifts to reveal a second monitor tracking a smaller, faster heartbeat.
related_events: Heart rate and blood pressure jolt detected in specimen
Scientists observe enlarged specimen in new case

name: Camera Reveals Second Heartbeat
description: The camera moves from the first cardiograph to a second one, showing a smaller, faster heartbeat. The scientists continue observing the creature in the case, which has grown significantly since before.
related_events: Camera reveals second cardiograph tracking faster heartbeat

name: Observing Ripley's Cognitive Test
description: Wren, Gediman, and General Perez stand behind a one-way mirror watching a scientist show picture cards to Ripley—images of a house, a dog, a boat. Ripley responds with visible irritation, her expressions flat, her posture bored. Wren and Gediman comment on her performance, noting her sharp cognitive responses. When Gediman says she seems 'freaked,' Wren gives him a sharp look and corrects him, insisting on more precise language. Perez says little, his arms crossed, his gaze fixed on Ripley. After a moment, he turns and walks out of the observation room without a word.
related_events: Wren and Gediman observe Ripley's test through one-way mirror
Scientist conducts test on Ripley using picture cards
General Perez joins Wren and Gediman in observing Ripley's test
Wren reprimands Gediman for using unscientific language
Perez observes Ripley through the glass and leaves the observation area

name: Ripley Awakens and Examines Her Body
description: Ripley crouches in a small, dark chamber, motionless under a dim light filtering through a glass pane in the ceiling. After a long stillness, she slowly lifts her hands, studying them. She touches her face, runs her fingers over her skin, and pulls at the neck of her tunic, revealing a scar along her chest. Her hand moves to her forearm, where she traces the tattooed number 8 near the crook of her elbow. She looks up, her expression unreadable.
related_events: Ripley crouches in dark chamber with minimal light
Ripley examines her hands, face, and body after remaining still
Ripley discovers tattooed number on her forearm

name: Guard Watches Ripley Through Floor Grate
description: A guard stands on the upper level, looking down through a square pane of glass set into the floor. Below, Ripley crouches in a small, dark chamber, motionless. The guard remains still, watching her. Other glass panels dot the floor, each revealing a glimpse of similar cells beneath.
related_events: Guard observes Ripley through glass pane in floor

name: Ripley Breaks Through Airlock Window to Reach Dock
description: Ripley drops to the ground and moves quickly toward the dock as the airlock doors begin to close. Hearing the automated warning, she rushes forward but finds she cannot stop the doors. Without hesitation, she throws herself through the window of the airlock and lands inside, gaining access to the docking area just before the seal completes.
related_events: Ripley drops to the ground and moves toward the dock
Airlock doors begin closing with automated warning
Ripley throws herself through an airlock window

name: Auriga Approaches Earth
description: The spacecraft Auriga moves toward Earth. The planet is still blue, but nearly two-thirds of its surface is hidden by a vast, rotating metal latticework in orbit. The structure turns slightly faster than the planet below. The ship heads for a section of the planet where the surface remains visible.
related_events: Auriga approaches Earth with partial planetary obscuration

name: Scientists Debate the Anomaly in the Observation Room
description: Gediman strides toward a second observation room, the other two scientists following close behind. He states they cannot terminate her—correcting himself to say 'it.' Perez demands to know what caused the incident, questioning the scientific basis, insisting cloned genes don't carry memory. Gediman responds that there have been cases. Perez cuts in, saying not like this. Wren hesitates, then suggests that while data is limited, some organisms exhibit a form of complex, inherited collective memory at the genetic level—comparable to instinct but more structured. Perez immediately connects the idea to the alien. Wren confirms it, adding that this case is different from the others. Without another word, Perez punches in a code, places his hand on the scanner, and the door to the observation room slides open. He steps inside, the others following behind him.
related_events: Gediman expresses inability to terminate subject
Perez questions cause of observed phenomenon
Gediman cites precedent cases
Wren proposes generational collective memory at genetic level

name: Perez Opens Door to Second Observation Room
description: The two scientists follow Perez as he strides toward the second observation room. Perez punches a code into the access panel and places his hand on the scanner. The door unlocks and opens. He steps inside, with the other two scientists entering right behind him.
related_events: Scientists proceed to second observation room
Perez enters second observation room after authentication

name: Surgical Extraction of the Alien from Ripley
description: The surgical team gathers around Ripley, whose body remains coated in aspic-slime and bears an unnatural blue hue. Gediman, wielding a lasersaw, cuts open her chest under the watchful eye of Dr. Wren, who stands slightly apart, observing. As the incision is made, another man steps in with a clamp and pulls the chest open. Gediman reaches inside and draws out a fetal but nearly full-grown Alien, its body still connected by thin umbilical threads to Ripley's chest. He holds it up as others move in with the amnio, an incubator filled with amniotic fluid. The Alien suddenly screams, its tiny mouth lined with teeth, and writhes free from Gediman's grip. The team scrambles in panic, but Gediman grabs the creature and thrusts it into the amnio. The top is sealed shut. As the others begin to remove the Alien from the room, Gediman and the surgeon start closing Ripley's wound. Then, without warning, Ripley's hand lashes out and seizes the surgeon's forearm. He cries out in pain as her fingers dig in, bones cracking, sending the team into chaos.
related_events: Scientists perform surgery to extract Alien from Ripley's chest
Alien awakens and struggles during extraction
Gediman captures and contains the Alien in amnio incubator

name: Ripley's Violent Awakening During Surgery
description: As the surgical team begins closing Ripley’s incision, her hand suddenly jerks upward and seizes the surgeon’s forearm with crushing force. A sharp crack echoes as his bone breaks. The surgeon cries out in pain, and the medical staff erupt into frantic movement, scrambling to respond. Instruments clatter to the floor as personnel collide with one another and equipment is knocked over. The sterile precision of the operating room collapses into chaos.
related_events: Ripley's hand lashes out and grabs surgeon's forearm during procedure
Surgeon suffers bone fracture from Ripley's involuntary grip
Medical team scrambles and knocks over equipment during emergency

name: Elgyn Issues Docking Threats and Mocks Rane
description: Elgyn speaks into the vidcom, delivering a harsh message: his authorization code is 'fuck you', and he orders the bay to open immediately or face General Perez’s wrath in the form of a 'Wichita stomp' on the recipient’s virgin ass. He switches off the device. Rane, standing nearby, asks what a Wichita stomp is. Elgyn responds with a smirk, assuring the others that the boy has never been with a woman. He then turns to Hillard and instructs her to bring the ship in on a three-oh descent, riding the parallel, and not to cut thrust until six hundred meters to give the station crew a scare.
related_events: Elgyn delivers a threatening authorization message via vidcom
Rane questions the meaning of 'Wichita stomp'
Elgyn asserts Rane's inexperience with women

name: Elgyn Orders Hillard to Execute a Controlled Descent
description: Elgyn turned to Hillard and told her to bring the ship in on a three-oh descent, riding the parallel. He emphasized not cutting thrust until six hundred meters. Hillard replied, 'Darlin', it's done,' and continued piloting the vessel. Elgyn placed his hand on her shoulder, then ran it up along her cheek before walking away.
related_events: Elgyn instructs Hillard to initiate a controlled descent
Hillard acknowledges and confirms the descent maneuver
Elgyn warns against cutting thrust too early

name: Elgyn Alerts Crew for Docking
description: After leaving the cockpit, Elgyn ran his hand from Hillard's shoulder up along her cheek. He walked through the hallway and stopped at a cubicle, sticking his head inside. 'Christie! St Just! Rise and shine. We're docking.'
related_events: Elgyn touches Hillard intimately during departure
Elgyn calls out to Christie and St Just to wake up

name: Perez, Wren, and Gediman Discuss Containment After Genetic Concerns
description: Perez turns to Wren and Gediman, asking if there will be further mutation in the specimen. Wren confirms there is a genetic mix and states that more study is needed. Gediman adds that he doesn't think mutation will continue, but uncertainty remains. Perez agrees to let them keep the specimen, but only under strict conditions: it must be secured, kept under observation, and moved away from the current location. As he speaks, an Alien—larger than before, with head ridges suggesting it is a young queen—rises behind him and lunges at his head. A reinforced plastic window, previously unseen, stops the creature. A laser grid activates, sparking against its face, and dark bile trails on the glass as the Alien pulls back. Perez turns and looks at it with the others. He remarks on how difficult it was to get to this point. Gediman responds sharply, and Wren gives him a look. Perez asks how soon the Alien will begin ovulating. Wren says it will happen in days, likely faster than normal. After a pause, Wren notes they will need supplies. Perez assures them the supplies are coming soon.
related_events: Team discusses potential for further mutation
Perez authorizes containment of the specimen

name: Alien Queen's Failed Attack on Perez
description: The alien, a large figure with pronounced head ridges marking it as a young queen, suddenly rises behind Perez and lunges at the back of his head. Its attack is halted by an unseen reinforced plastic window. On impact, a thin laser grid flares to life, sending sparks across the alien's face. Dark trails of bile streak the glass as the creature pulls back. Perez turns toward the others, all of them now facing the alien, watching its movements in the aftermath of the attempt.
related_events: Alien lunges at the back of a character's head
Reinforced plastic window stops the alien's attack
Laser grid activates and shocks the alien
Alien's bile leaves trails on the glass
Perez and others react to the alien's attack

name: Wren Reports Specimen's Accelerated Development
description: Wren examines the specimen and notes that it will begin ovulating within days—sooner than anticipated. She states that more supplies are needed to manage it properly. Perez responds that the supplies are already on their way.
related_events: Wren warns about accelerated ovulation of the specimen
Wren requests additional supplies for containment
Perez confirms arrival of requested supplies

name: Ripley Escapes Through the Ventilation Shaft
description: Ripley rolls to her feet and scans the room for an exit. Above her, a vent rattles as the newborn alien forces its head through the opening, its body too large to follow. It thrashes, stuck and writhing. Ripley grabs a nearby pipe, kicks the vent grate open, and pulls herself into the shaft just as the creature lunges. She climbs fast, disappearing into the dark vertical passage as the alien below screeches in frustration.
related_events: Newborn alien attacks Ripley in confined space
Ripley evades newborn alien and escapes through ventilation shaft

name: Ripley Tears Loose a Burning Pole to Release a Steam Barrier
description: Ripley climbs quickly through the narrow ventilation shaft, her hands scraping against the hot metal walls. As she reaches for a metal pole, her hand sears upon contact, steam rising from her skin. She cries out, lets go, then grabs it again despite the pain. With a violent yank, she rips the pole from the wall. Burning steam erupts behind her, gushing into the shaft. The pursuing alien drones and the newborn recoil as the scalding cloud fills the passage. Ripley kicks through another vent grate above and vanishes into the next section, leaving the creatures behind in the haze.
related_events: Ripley endures burning pole to release scalding steam barrier
Ripley kicks through vent grate to escape pursuing aliens

name: Call Kills Newborn Alien Aboard the Betty
description: The newborn alien darts across the room inside the Betty, knocking over canisters and vanishing behind instruments. Vriess scrambles backward, knocking equipment aside as he tries to escape. Johner opens fire, but Call shouts at him to stop, warning that the ship’s hull is too thin to withstand bullets. Ignoring her, Johner keeps shooting as the creature leaps from the shadows toward Call. She stumbles, trips, and in one motion pulls her hand back, flicks her wrist—the stiletto blade snaps out just in time. The creature flies onto the blade, impaling it through the mouth and out the back of its head. Blood sprays across Call and the floor. The alien writhes briefly, then collapses, the stiletto melting inside its body.
related_events: Vriess flees from baby alien inside the Betty
Johner opens fire on baby alien aboard the Betty
Call warns Johner about gunfire endangering Betty's hull
Call impales newborn alien with stiletto blade

name: Johner Takes Command After Alien Attack
description: The newborn alien lunges at Call, who stumbles back and draws a stiletto blade with a flick of her wrist. The blade snaps out just in time, impaling the creature through the mouth as it flies toward her face. Blood sprays across Call and the floor. The alien writhes briefly and collapses, the stiletto melting inside its body. Johner immediately turns to Vriess and shouts for him to get behind the wheel. Vriess scrambles to obey, taking control of the Betty as Johner assumes command of the ship.
related_events: Johner takes command and orders Vriess to pilot Betty

name: Crew Escapes Jeep and Descends Staircase Under Alien Threat
description: Ripley drives the jeep down a narrow hall lined with windows overlooking black space until a steep staircase blocks their path. She slams the brakes, the jeep spinning out before coming to a stop. The crew quickly climbs out, Di Stephano pulling Vriess from the vehicle. At the far end of the hall, aliens advance. The crew opens fire, bullets striking the creatures, their blood splattering the walls and floor, eating into the metal. The ship issues a warning: potential hull breach, clear the sector. Di Stephano points to the stairs and shouts, 'Down here!' The group begins descending. St Just remains behind, stepping out of the jeep with difficulty, looking at his wound. Johner calls out to him, but St Just turns away, walking slowly toward the approaching aliens. He takes a handful of pills, swallows them, and smiles faintly as he raises his weapons. The ship sounds another warning. The crew continues down the staircase as the aliens close in on St Just.
related_events: Ripley drives jeep to staircase and brakes abruptly
Crew exits jeep under alien threat
Di Stephano directs crew down staircase
Crew begins descent down staircase
Ship issues hull breach warning

name: Crew Fires on Aliens in Hallway
description: The crew opens fire as the aliens advance down the narrow hallway. Bullets strike the creatures, sending sprays of blood across the walls and floor. The blood sizzles and eats into the metal surfaces, burning through the material as the gunfire continues.
related_events: Crew opens fire on approaching aliens
Alien blood corrodes walls and floor

name: St Just Stays Behind to Face the Aliens
description: The jeep skids to a stop at the base of a steep staircase, and the crew scrambles out, helping Vriess as the aliens advance down the narrow hall. Di Stephano points to the stairs, yelling for everyone to follow. One by one, they descend—except St Just, who struggles to exit the vehicle and stands motionless at the top, looking down at his wound. Johner turns, noticing he hasn't moved. 'St Just! Come on, man!' he shouts. St Just glances at the wound, then back at Johner. Without urgency, he turns and walks away from the stairs, toward the approaching aliens. 'You go,' he says. 'I'm bored.' The ship blares another warning to evacuate the sector. St Just pulls out a handful of pills, swallows them, and stands his ground. As the aliens close in, he raises his guns.
related_events: St Just remains behind due to injury
Johner calls out to St Just to follow the crew
St Just declares he is bored and tells crew to leave
St Just walks toward the aliens after refusing to follow
St Just takes pills and prepares to face aliens alone
St Just raises his guns as aliens close in

name: Purvis Attacks Ripley with Metal Bar, Crew Subdues Him
description: Purvis lunges from the shadows, swinging a metal bar that strikes Ripley in the side, knocking her off balance. St Just and Christie spin toward him, weapons raised, and shout for him to drop the rod. The rest of the crew rushes in as Purvis swings the bar wildly, his eyes wide with fear. His strength fades quickly, and the rod clatters to the floor. He collapses, trembling, looking around in confusion. The crew surrounds him, weapons still ready, as he stammers questions about where he is and what’s happening.
related_events: Purvis attacks Ripley with a metal bar in panic
Crew confronts Purvis and demands he drop the weapon

name: Ripley Reveals Purvis's Infection
description: Something leaps from the shadows, a metal bar striking Ripley in the side and throwing her off balance. St Just and Christie spin, weapons raised, nearly shooting the figure in the corner—Purvis, wild-eyed, swinging the rod in panic. He collapses, the bar clattering to the floor, and looks around in confusion, asking where he is and what’s happening. Call urges him to come with them, but Ripley steps forward, sniffing the air, her head cocked. She declares that Purvis is carrying an alien inside him. Johner reacts in disgust, Vriess voices concern, and Call argues they can freeze Purvis and remove the creature later. Wren says it’s impossible here—the lab is destroyed. St Just quietly suggests killing Purvis quickly and painlessly. Ripley cuts in, stepping in front of Wren, and tells Purvis directly: there’s a monster in his stomach. She explains that the smugglers hijacked his cryotube, sold him to Wren, and Wren implanted the alien. In a few hours, it will burst from his chest and kill him. Purvis stares, stunned, then asks who she is. Ripley answers, 'I'm the monster's mother,' and walks away. Call insists Purvis come with them. Christie moves to guide him, warning him not to resist. The group heads out into the hall, moving cautiously through the quiet corridors.
related_events: Ripley detects an alien organism inside Purvis
Ripley reveals the alien organism inside Purvis to the crew

name: The Crew Debates Purvis's Fate
description: After Purvis collapses in fear and drops the metal bar, St Just reads his name from his coveralls and tells him they're leaving the ship. Purvis stammers, confused, claiming he was in cryo en route to Xarem for work. He remembers waking up and seeing something horrible. Call urges him to come with them, but Ripley steps forward, sniffing the air, and declares that Purvis has an alien inside him. Purvis panics, demanding to know what is inside him. Wren starts to explain, but Ripley interrupts, bluntly telling him a monster is in his stomach, implanted by Wren after the smugglers hijacked his cryotube. She adds that it will burst out and kill him in hours. Call insists they take Purvis with them and freeze him on the Betty for later treatment. Wren confirms there's no way to remove the creature here—the lab is destroyed. St Just quietly suggests shooting Purvis in the back of the head, calling it painless and the safest option. Call rejects it, pushing for the freezing plan. Johnner challenges Call's authority, asking since when he's in charge. Call snaps back, calling Johnner the product of parents who never had balls. Vriess steps in, telling them to ease off. Christie moves to guide Purvis along, warning him to stay calm or he'll be shot. The group begins to move out.
related_events: Crew debates whether to save or execute Purvis
Call asserts leadership and proposes freezing Purvis for medical treatment
Johnner challenges Call's authority
Call retorts to Johnner's challenge with a personal insult
Vriess intervenes to defuse conflict within the group

name: Christie Escorts Purvis Under Armed Guard
description: Christie moves beside Purvis, her weapon raised and ready. She orders him to stay close and follow every command, warning that any sudden move will be met with gunfire. The group advances down the hall, weapons scanning the shadows. Purvis stumbles slightly, his breath ragged, but keeps moving under her direction. No one speaks. The corridor stretches ahead, dark and silent, as they proceed together, alert for any sign of movement.
related_events: Christie escorts Purvis under threat of violence

name: The Group Advances Through the Hall
description: The group moves through a dimly lit hallway, weapons ready, eyes scanning the shadows. The silence presses in around them as they step carefully forward, checking each corner before proceeding. No one speaks. Every footfall is measured, every breath held. They stay close, shoulders nearly touching, weapons raised, moving as one through the narrow passage.
related_events: Group moves cautiously through the hall sensing danger

name: Ripley Crawls to the Escape Hatch
description: Ripley lies on the floor, breathing heavily, her body drained of strength. She tries to push herself up but falters, collapsing back down. After a moment, she forces herself onto her hands and knees, then begins crawling slowly toward the open hatch beneath the ship. The wind howls from below as blue sky and rushing air fill the space beyond the opening. Her movements are strained, each inch forward a struggle. As she drags herself forward, she mutters, 'God...', her voice weak, barely audible over the noise around her.
related_events: Ripley struggles to move after exhaustion
Ripley crawls toward the hatch under the ship
Ripley mutters in exhaustion

name: Johner Commands Emergency Descent on the Betty
description: The crew of the Betty scrambles to avert disaster as the ship plummets toward the surface. Johner barks orders to engage full downdraft thrust, his voice tense with urgency. Above the roar of the engines, the ship's warning system blares repeatedly: braking systems have failed, collision is imminent. 'No shit,' Johner snaps in response. The alarms continue, counting down the final seconds before impact. 'Almost there,' he shouts, gripping the controls as the Betty lurches downward, still racing to stabilize before it hits the ground.
related_events: Crew races to escape before ship collision
Johner shouts commands to initiate full downdraft thrust
Ship warning system alerts of braking failure and collision
Johner responds sarcastically to ship's warning

name: Newborn Alien Appears in Docking Bay Window
description: Ripley crawls toward the hatch, her breath heavy, movements slow and strained. Above her, through the window of the docking bay, the newborn alien appears, its form visible as it looms in the glass. The wind howls from below as the outer airlock door gapes open, sky and turbulence filling the space beneath the ship. The creature watches, motionless, as Ripley continues her struggle toward the hatch.
related_events: Newborn appears in docking bay window

name: Ripley Crawls Toward the Hatch as the Airlock Opens
description: The large outer airlock door beneath the ship swings open, revealing a stretch of blue sky and unleashing a rush of wind into the vessel. Ripley, on her hands and knees, crawls toward the hatch, her breath heavy, her movements slow and strained. Above, the newborn appears in the window of the docking bay, watching.
related_events: Outer airlock door opens beneath the ship

name: Call Evades the Auriga and the Betty Is Damaged in the Aftermath
description: Call steers the Betty sharply, narrowly avoiding a collision with the Auriga as the larger ship hurtles uncontrollably toward the planet. The Auriga slams into the snow-covered mountains below, erupting in a massive explosion that lights up the sky. The force of the impact rocks the Betty violently. Sparks burst from an instrument panel, flames erupt nearby, and warning lights flash across the cockpit. Johner grabs a fire extinguisher and sprays foam at the blaze. As the ship shudders through turbulent air, a loud banging echoes from above. The crew looks up, startled by the sound.
related_events: Call maneuvers the Betty to avoid collision with the Auriga
Auriga crashes into snow-covered mountains
Betty sustains damage and experiences onboard fire
Johner extinguishes fire on the Betty
Betty crew detects unexplained banging overhead

name: Ripley's Fight on the Auriga's Hull
description: As the Auriga plummets toward Earth, Ripley clings to the ship's exterior, her grip slipping as the vessel shudders violently. An alien advances toward her, dragging itself forward with its legs and tendrils, hissing. It lashes out with a tentacle, but Ripley rolls aside, barely avoiding the strike. The ship bucks again, and she is thrown free—her hand snaps out, catching the newborn's tentacle just in time. The newborn thrashes, slamming her against the hull in a brutal impact. Dazed but determined, she reaches for an external grate and begins pulling herself along the surface, climbing away as the ship continues its descent.
related_events: Ripley struggles to hold on to the Auriga's exterior
Alien attacks Ripley on the Auriga's hull
Ripley is thrown from the Auriga's hull and grabs the newborn's tentacle
Newborn attacks Ripley by smashing her against the ship
Ripley attempts to open hatch doors by force

name: Call Rescues Ripley as the Newborn Attacks
description: Johner spots Ripley clinging to the hatch of the Betty, the massive newborn alien moving nearby. He refuses to open the door, warning that something else is out there. Call insists, shoving past him and taking control of the hatch release. As the door begins to slide open, the alien turns toward the opening, drawn by the new threat. Call climbs halfway out, aiming a grenade launcher at the creature. She fires once, striking it, but the ship lurches violently and her second shot goes wide. The alien rears up, advancing on the hatch. Ripley, still outside, pulls herself toward the opening. Call grabs her just as the alien lunges, yanking Ripley inside and slamming the hatch shut. The creature slams into the sealed door with full force as the Betty shudders through the air.
related_events: Call confronts Johner over opening the hatch for Ripley
Johner restrains Call to prevent hatch release
Call takes control of the hatch release and opens the door
Alien turns toward the open hatch and moves to enter
Call confronts the Alien with a grenade launcher at the open hatch
Call's second grenade shot misses due to ship movement
Ripley reaches the open hatch as the Alien advances
Call pulls Ripley inside and seals the hatch as the Alien attacks

name: Medical Examination and Unexpected Healing
description: Ripley sits on a table as Gediman draws her blood and examines her eyes. He places the blood sample into a test beaker and then shows Wren a series of photographs depicting Ripley's scar tissue, pointing out signs of rapid recession. Wren, reviewing the images, asks when the changes occurred. Gediman tells him it happened within the last day. Wren declares the results promising and approves further tests on strength and coordination. He approaches Ripley, studying her face with a satisfied expression. Without warning, Ripley seizes Wren by the throat, pulls him close, and demands to know why. Gediman, stunned, reacts only after a moment, slamming his hand on the alarm. Red lights flash and a klaxon sounds. A guard bursts in and fires a shockrifle at Ripley, sending her flying into the corner. Wren collapses to his knees, gasping. The guard keeps his weapon trained on Ripley, who slowly sits up, dazed, and quietly asks, 'Why...?'
related_events: Gediman draws blood from Ripley and examines her

description: The aliens' blood eats through the hull, and with a sudden roar, the corridor ruptures. The crew races ahead, thrown off their feet by the rushing wind as the garden sector is ripped open and sucked into the void. Ripley is the last to reach the door, but the pressure change hurls her backward. She slams into the closing sector door just as it seals, her body crashing against it before she collapses. name: Call Helps Ripley After the Blast
description: After the crew escapes the garden sector, Ripley is the last through the door. The sudden decompression hurls her backward, slamming her into the closing section door. She falls unconscious, dazed from the impact to the back of her head. Call stops, turns, and runs back to her. She grabs Ripley and pulls her up. "Can you walk?" Ripley stammers, "I think I..." Call cuts her off. "I'm not fucking carrying you." Ripley doesn't respond—she's not listening. She clutches her ears, eyes wide. "Mistake... mistake..." she mutters. "I can hear them, in the hive... it's close... We're on the hive." Call stares. "What...?" Ripley whispers, "She's in pain." Then, the floor panels explode upward. Six aliens burst through, surrounding them. Call barely has time to react before Ripley lunges, grabbing her and throwing her fifteen feet down the corridor. The aliens close in on Ripley. She fights, but her strength fails. One slams her to the ground. She agrees, taking a drink. He points out they’re on Earth now, with plenty of places to get lost. Call nods, acknowledging she’s heard the same. Later, she hands the bottle to Ripley, who takes a sip and smiles faintly. Call asks what they should do now. Ripley looks out at the distant city lights and says she doesn’t know—she’s a stranger here herself. The two stand together in silence, watching the flames as the newborn burns in the fire below.

name: Ripley Identifies the Queen

He repeats the word, correcting her tone, and she offers a faint, fleeting smile. The moment passes. She looks at him and asks how they got her. He explains they used blood samples from Fiori 16, kept on ice, and asks if she remembers the place. She ignores the question and asks if the creature grows. He confirms it does, rapidly. Wren enters, identifying the Company as Weyland Yutani, explaining it no longer exists, absorbed by Walmart long ago. He assures her things have changed, that they are military, not corporate, and that the creature holds potential for alloys, vaccines, and scientific advancement. Ripley laughs bitterly, saying she's proud. Wren calls the creature a wonder, valuable once harnessed. 'It's a cancer,' she says. 'You can't teach it tricks.' Wren falls silent and steps away. Her legs are bound, glued to the chamber's roof, leaving her angled downward. She blinks into the dim light, taking in the chamber around her. Ten other figures are strung up in the same manner, encircling the space. Below, forty feet down, the Alien Queen lies on her back, belly swollen and pulsating, partially cocooned at the edge of a dark pool of blood and ichor. Her head lolls weakly, emitting a low moan of pain. Several aliens move around her, spitting resin and vomiting dark fluid onto her body. Ripley's eyes scan the chamber. No eggs are present. She whispers, 'No eggs...' A voice beside her answers—Gediman, strung up like the others, blood seeping from his feet into the pool below. Gediman explains that she reproduces asexually, capable of self-impregnation, with multiple sets of ovaries. She no longer needs hosts, he says, her body evolved to birth countless offspring on her own. As he speaks, the Queen lets out a piercing shriek, her limbs thrashing, the bulge in her abdomen shifting violently. Ripley stares down at her, then pulls against her restraints, breathing hard.

name: Boarding the Jeep and Fleeing Through the Garden
description: The crew discovers a small loading truck parked in the garden and quickly gather around it. Vriess climbs into the back after taking a bite of a pear, and the others pile onto the flatbed. Ripley hesitates for a moment, holding her head as if overcome by a sudden pain, but shakes it off and moves to the driver's seat. Call reaches over and flips the ignition. Ripley, unfamiliar with the controls, looks briefly puzzled before the engine hums to life. She thanks Call and steers the vehicle forward. The electric jeep moves quietly along the narrow access paths, surrounded by dense vegetation—wheat, corn, and towering cannabis plants. As they reach a crossroads, Ripley stops briefly, asking which way to go, but before anyone can answer, an alien lunges from the brush and attacks Hillard. Screams erupt as the creature burrows into her head. St Just opens fire, blowing the alien apart just as Ripley slams the accelerator. The jeep surges forward, swerving through the garden as more aliens emerge—some leaping from the undergrowth, others racing alongside the vehicle or sprinting along the lattice above. One drops onto the hood, another grabs the side; Vriess shoots the first, sending it crashing away. description: Vriess lies on a steel dolly, working beneath the massive thresher, its blades inches above him. He calls out for someone to check the sequence timer, but there’s no answer. From the control panel, a hand reaches in and flips the ON switch. The thresher roars to life, blades spinning wildly. Vriess rolls out from under the machine just in time, then slams a lever that converts the dolly into a wheelchair. 'Goddamnit!' he shouts. Johner jumps down from the thresher, laughing. 'Thought I'd give you a little haircut there.' 'You fuck!' Vriess snaps, glaring at him. Call climbs down from the other side of the machine and shuts it off. name: The Crew Steps Onto the Platform
description: The ship glides slowly into the bay, settling with a gentle thud as it aligns its hatch with the grated platform. The top of the vessel meets the level of the walkway, where three soldiers in full armor stand motionless. The hatch creaks open, and the crew begins to emerge, one by one. Johner steps out first, his bright turquoise bowling shirt clashing with the sterile surroundings. Elgyn and St Just follow, their long leather dusters trailing behind them. Vriess comes last, wheeling himself down the ramp in his distinctive chair. The soldiers remain silent, watching as the crew passes. One soldier stops Johner, touching a bulge under his jacket. A green light on the soldier’s glove flashes red. Johner opens his coat to reveal a large thermos. 'Moonshine. My own. Much more dangerous,' he says. The soldier doesn’t react, only shakes his head. 'Sorry, sir.' Elgyn mutters to Perez, 'What, do you think we're going to hijack the vessel? All eight of us?' Perez replies, 'No, I think one of your asshole crew is going to get drunk and put a bullet through the hull. We are in space, Elgyn.' Vriess reaches the soldier and asks, 'Wanna check the chair?' description: At the guards' station, the group gathers around a console projecting a holographic schematic of the ship. Wren points out multiple hull breaches and identifies the aft-sector as heavily compromised, with high threat concentrations. Ripley warns that the aliens are breeding rapidly, their numbers increasing due to the cloned cells, and that they’ll stay close to the group. Johner voices concern about whether the Betty is still safe, but Christie checks the dock and confirms it’s intact, proposing they escape to the ship. DiStephano suggests a route through the lift shaft and a maintenance tunnel to avoid the most damaged areas. Wren agrees to override the access tunnel door’s security system. After reviewing the path, the group finalizes their plan: they will move through the labs, the kitchen, and into the lift shaft, then through the maintenance tunnel to reach the Betty.

He warns the group not to shoot the aliens, explaining that their blood is molecular acid. Wren and Christie confirm the danger, but Johner insists he’ll fire anyway. Wren reveals that after the ship was damaged, it switched to autopilot and is now on a course to Earth. Call checks the systems and calculates they have three hours until arrival. Hillard asks where Earth is, and Wren admits he forgot to mention the autopilot protocol. The group realizes the ship has been moving since the attack. Johner refuses to go to Earth, and Call voices concern about the aliens reaching the planet. Ripley says it would mean 'the end.' St. Just dismisses the fate of Earth, but Call suggests destroying the ship to stop the threat. Christie focuses on immediate survival and orders the group to move out. Ripley takes point, and the group advances in formation.

The room is in disarray, littered with wreckage and the remains of three bodies—each with chest cavities torn open. Johner stares at the corpses, visibly shaken, and asks Ripley if she’s ever faced the creatures before. She replies that she died during a previous encounter with them. Christie, undeterred, urges everyone to keep moving. She and Vriess step into the next chamber, followed shortly by St. Just and Ripley.

name: Wren Activates Cryotube Awakening and Alien Egg Deployment
description: The guard unlocked the cargo and slid off the side panel, revealing the stacked cryotubes. One by one, the tubes were moved to the side of the chamber as a second unit was wheeled in, bringing ten cryotubes in total. The scientists left the chamber and entered an adjoining room with a long glass window overlooking the chamber. The last guard exited, and the door locked behind him. Wren began pressing buttons, triggering the cryotube release sequence. The glass tops of the cryotubes slid open, and temperature and lifesign gauges showed changes. A section of the ceiling slowly lowered and rotated, revealing ten alien eggs attached to its underside, now positioned above the sleepers. One of the sleepers briefly opened their eyes. All ten eggs opened at the same time.

name: Ripley Confronts Johner and Fights Off the Crew
description: Ripley stands alone in the conference hall, dribbling a basketball beneath a makeshift hoop. Johner approaches, grinning, and taunts her with a challenge to play. She tells him to get away. When he persists, she strikes him hard in the chest, sending him flying backward into a cluster of chairs. Hillard lunges at her from behind, but Ripley throws her off effortlessly and hurls the basketball at her with such force it bursts. Christie swings an ashtray and hits Ripley in the face, drawing a thin line of blood from her nose. Ripley snaps back up, grabs Christie by the throat, and knocks the ashtray from his hand. Johner charges again, and she leaps on him, slamming him to the ground, snarling as she pins him, her teeth bared toward his throat.

description: A fully grown alien is released into observation pen six under controlled conditions. Wren and Gediman watch closely as a soldier opens the containment cage. The creature surges forward, rushing into the pen before the heavy doors slam shut behind it. They speak about the aliens' ultrasonic communication, and Ripley tells him she can hear the sounds. Without warning, she pulls him into a deep kiss. Call reacts to Johner's drink with a grimace, then pushes back from the table, stumbling as she stands. She trips slightly while leaving, nearly falling before catching herself on the doorway. Once out of sight, her movements become steady and deliberate. She walks purposefully down the corridor, heading toward restricted areas of the facility.

name: Call's Assassination Attempt and the Empty Scar
description: Call entered the restricted area by inputting a code on the keypad and moved silently through the corridors. She reached Ripley's cell and slipped inside, drawing a concealed stiletto. Crouching beside the sleeping figure, she prepared to strike—but paused, her eyes catching the scar across Ripley's chest. She stared, realizing the implant was already gone. Ripley's eyes opened, sharp and aware. She looked at Call without fear, meeting her gaze. Call lowered the blade, then pulled it back completely, stepping away. 'It's already out,' Call said, her voice tight. Ripley sat up slowly, silent for a moment, then gave a faint, cryptic smile. 'They're here,' she said.

The wound heals quickly, revealing she is not the original Ellen Ripley, but a lab-grown construct. She tells Call the alien is inside her, not fully awakened, but destined to emerge. When Call begs for help to stop it, Ripley says it cannot be stopped. She suddenly grabs Call in a chokehold, holds her tightly, then lets go. The third alien thrashes as its blood sprays, hissing violently as it eats through the floor. The corrosive fluid burns downward, cutting through multiple levels below. Alarms blare as Gediman rushes to the control panel and triggers the failsafe freezing gas, but the mist floods the chamber too late. The two attacking aliens leap into the hole created by the melting floor and vanish into the lower levels. Moments later, one of them surges back up through the opening, lunging at Gediman before he can react. It drags him screaming through the gap, his body vanishing from sight. The remaining guard stands frozen, eyes wide, unable to move as the sounds of tearing metal and distant alarms echo through the facility.

name: Wren Activates Liquid Nitrogen Trap to Freeze Aliens
description: After the aliens attack and kill a group of soldiers near the queen's chamber, the group takes cover. Wren notices the remains of the queen and points out the nearby observation room they must pass through. A burst of gunfire narrowly misses them, and they witness two aliens tearing through soldiers. Call attempts to rush forward, but Ripley restrains her. Once the aliens vanish from view, an eerie silence follows. Wren suggests using the liquid nitrogen failsafe system in the cages to freeze the aliens. He moves to the control panel and prepares to trigger it. The others position themselves to draw the aliens in. Vriess and Johner call out to attract them. Four aliens approach the cage, hesitate, but do not enter. Ripley proposes using bait, suggesting they throw someone into the cage to lure the creatures. Tensions rise as the group argues, some pointing weapons at one another. As the aliens begin to charge, Wren hits the button. A blast of freezing gas floods the area, encasing three of the aliens in ice. The fourth turns to flee, but St. Just shoots it from a distance. The group stands in silence, catching their breath.

Ripley grabs her, insisting they must act if they want to survive, and tells Wren to activate the failsafe. As three aliens leap toward the group, Wren releases the liquid nitrogen, freezing the creatures in place. The fourth alien turns to flee, but St Just shoots it from a distance. The group stands in silence, breathing heavily, the air thick with fear and tension.

She glances at her own arm, where the number 8 is tattooed on her skin. Without a word, she pushes forward, entering the facility despite visible warning signs. Inside, rows of containment units stretch into the darkness. Within them, deformed and lifeless bodies float in fluid—each labeled with a number, each a failed attempt. Ripley walks slowly among them, her expression shifting as she recognizes the truth: she is not the first. She is one of them.

Hillard shot toward the attacker. Ripley called out for the others to keep moving, to get past her. The survivors kicked hard through the water, fighting panic and dwindling air until they broke the surface, gasping.

name: Escape Through the Web: Surface Under Siege
description: The survivors reached the surface but found themselves trapped in a thick web of alien goo just beneath the air. Call sliced a hole in the web with her stiletto, and Ripley tore it open wider, allowing most of the group to escape. Di Stephano became stuck and drowned in the web. As Ripley surfaced, an alien grabbed her foot underwater, and once she broke free, a facehugger lunged at her. Call spotted another facehugger leaping toward Wren and shot it midair. Christie and Vriess emerged and immediately opened fire on nearby alien eggs, destroying several in a sweeping barrage as the group struggled to regroup in the chaos.

name: Escape the Ambush in the Water Chamber
description: After breaking the surface, Ripley is suddenly attacked by a facehugger that latches onto her throat. She tears it free and crushes it in fury. From below, three aliens surge upward. St Just fires at one closing in on Ripley, killing it before it reaches her. Johner grabs a plasma burner and fires into the water, electrifying it as another alien emerges. The crew opens fire on the creature, bringing it down. Hillard and Johner pull Di Stephano from the water, unconscious and unresponsive, but after a moment he gasps and revives. Christie stares at the dead facehugger, then holds it up, calling out. Another facehugger leaps from the shadows toward him, but Johner shoots it midair. St Just and Ripley scramble clear of the blood-filled pool, and Johner declares the area unsafe. Christie examines the scene, then says the attack was no accident—it was a trap.

name: Climb the Lift Shaft and Wren's Betrayal
description: The group rushed into a lift shaft, prying open the doors and climbing up narrow ladders to escape the aliens closing in. Wren led the ascent, reaching a crawl space ledge first and struggling to open a maintenance access door. Behind him, Call handed him her gun, hoping he could force it open. Instead, Wren turned and shot her through the chest. She fell backward, plummeting down the shaft and landing on an elevator below. Vriess roared in rage and opened fire, but Wren had already unlocked the door and slipped inside. Ripley lunged for the ledge just in time, grabbing it as the door slammed shut and locked, leaving her stranded outside. Below, the aliens smashed through the lower door, climbing up with facehuggers clinging to their backs, as the group splintered in chaos.

name: St Just Hangs Upside Down to Shoot Alien During Shaft Climb
description: The group ascends the lift shaft as alarms blare and metal groans around them. St Just swings upside down from his harness, fires at a nearby alien, and drops back into position. Below, a loud clacking echoes up the shaft. Purvis shouts a warning—two aliens are climbing fast from beneath. Ripley spots one lunging toward her, lashes out, and loses her grip, falling until she grabs a metal pole and clings to it. Above, Christie struggles as an alien attacks. She fires, forcing it back momentarily. Vriess shouts encouragement while fumbling to reload. The alien strikes again, dragging Christie away. Johner reaches her, checks her pulse, and shakes his head. Hillard pulls out a blade, cuts the cord connecting Christie to Vriess, and her body vanishes into the dark shaft. The group climbs harder, breathing ragged, as the aliens close in from below. Ripley yells that they’re locked in and must keep moving. Johner urges them onward despite the distance still to go. The clacking grows louder. Metal scrapes against metal as the creatures climb faster, gaining ground. The survivors push upward, hands raw, muscles burning, racing toward the next exit.

description: Call falls down the lift shaft and lands on an elevator. She lies motionless, unresponsive. A facehugger approaches, scuttling toward her, and climbs onto her face. It presses close, testing for breath, and probes her nostrils. After a moment, it recoils, then retreats, leaving her body behind.
